To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) net migration patterns by race/ethnicity and rural-urban county type are stable over the 60 year period; 2) net migration by age is consistent over time within rural-urban and race/ethnic county types; and 3) net migration patterns are changing over time in large urban counties, with a shift in net outflow from younger to older age groups.

1) age-specific net migration has been a consistent process over time within county type, 2) age-specific net in- or out-migration patterns are different by race/ethnicity and rural-urban location, 3) the net migration patterns of the White and Black populations have converged over time, and 4) the net Hispanic migration patterns have become more similar to the net White migration patterns over time.
